title: Thai Beet Tartlets
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional Thai desserts. These beet tartlets are perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out small squares of pastry, about 3 inches per side.
In a bowl, mix together cooked beet, soy sauce, sugar, eggs, salt, and water.
Place a small spoonful of the beet mixture onto one half of each pastry square.
Fold the other half of the pastry square over the filling to form a triangle or a square shape.
Press the edges together to seal the tartlet.
Brush the tops of the tartlets with a little bit of water and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
